title: Polycell compact process plan
description: The existing compact plan projection emitted by the Polycell gateway. Execution mappings extend its original routing fields. Hashes use the gateway's existing sorted-key Python JSON serialization profile, with non-finite numbers rejected.

output.description: Process result mapping or literal value.

input.description: Arguments mapping or reference, resolved before invocation.

plan_hash.description: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(plan_without_plan_hash, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False), using separators comma-space and colon-space. All visible execution mappings participate.
